task: WE-1 POS Cashier Loyalty CTA — UX placement + WCAG 2.1 review

findings.summary: Sibling placement in the existing operator-bar nav (PosComponent.vue:160-170) is the most discoverable, design-coherent location. Use PosV5Button ghost variant with brand tone to mirror the existing Customer Screen / Floorplan / Caisse buttons. Add ARIA + keyboard parity. Mind the `dineInEnabled` swap.

discoverability.rating: GOOD — sits in the operator-bar nav alongside Tracker / Customer Screen / Caisse, which the cashier scans before every order. Right of the search input strip, visible at all viewports >= md.
discoverability.alternative_rejected: Cart panel placement (aside#pos-cart): TOO HIDDEN — cashier focused on items grid, cart panel is a secondary surface on mobile/tablet.
discoverability.alternative_rejected_2: Floating action button: visually noisy, conflicts with existing pos-v5-success-flash overlay.

visual_hierarchy.icon_recommendation: 🎁 (gift/loyalty) — distinct from 📋 (Tracker), 🖥️ (Customer Screen), 🪑 (Floorplan), 💵 (No-sale), 🏦 (Caisse). Avoids icon collision.
visual_hierarchy.tone: PosV5Button variant=ghost tone=neutral (no halo by default). Switch to tone=ready when CTA is visible AND a non-terminal order exists, so the cashier sees the affordance light up when actionable.
visual_hierarchy.label: {{ $t('pos.loyalty.redeem.title') }} → 'Appliquer une réduction fidélité' (FR) / 'Apply loyalty discount' (EN). Truncated on small viewports per existing `hidden lg:inline` pattern on label span (mirrors lines 146, 158, 169, 187, 205).

state_machine.disabled_visible: dineInEnabled === false AND currentLoyaltyOrderId === null. Button shown but disabled (greyed) with title='Aucune commande en cours' so cashier understands the affordance exists but requires an active order.
state_machine.active: dineInEnabled === false AND currentLoyaltyOrderId !== null AND order non-terminal AND non-PAID.
state_machine.post_apply: After successful redemption, modal shows success band → close → CTA stays visible until order transitions terminal. Cashier sees CTA tone shift back to neutral as a feedback cue.

interaction_flow: 1. Cashier creates order (non-CASH path). PaymentComponent emits order:confirmed with non-PAID payload.
3. Cashier clicks → PosLoyaltyRedeemModal opens (existing modal, no UX delta).
4. Cashier enters loyalty code + points → submits → server applies → modal shows success band → modal auto-closes after 1.5s (existing behavior).
5. CTA stays visible (order still non-terminal) but the cashier visually sees the success-flash overlay (pos-v5-success-flash) confirming application.
6. Order finalizes (terminal state) → CTA hides → currentLoyaltyOrderId cleared on next cart action.

wcag_2_1.1_1_1_text_alternatives: PASS — emoji icon paired with text label. aria-label fallback via :title= attribute on PosV5Button.
wcag_2_1.1_3_1_info_relationships: PASS — button is inside <nav> with implicit list semantics. ARIA already covered by PosV5Button primitive.
wcag_2_1.1_4_3_contrast: PASS — PosV5Button ghost variant uses --pos-v5-border + --pos-v5-ink (both >= 4.5:1 against panel bg per V5 design tokens).
wcag_2_1.2_1_1_keyboard: PASS — PosV5Button renders as <button> by default; Tab order natural after Caisse button. Enter/Space triggers click.
wcag_2_1.2_4_4_link_purpose: PASS — label 'Appliquer une réduction fidélité' is self-describing.
wcag_2_1.3_2_2_on_input: PASS — disabled state is not a context change.
wcag_2_1.3_3_1_error_identification: PASS — modal already surfaces error_code via role='alert' (PosLoyaltyRedeemModal.vue:35-38).
wcag_2_1.4_1_2_name_role_value: PASS — disabled state communicated via [disabled] attribute (already supported by PosV5Button).

aria_attributes_required: title attribute → maps to button title + tooltip via PosV5Button :title prop.
aria-disabled='true' when CTA disabled (no current order). Already auto-handled by PosV5Button via :disabled.
a11y_evaluation.screen_reader_announcements: When CTA toggles enabled→disabled (cashier creates new order vs. resetCart), no aria-live region update needed — cashier interaction is visual-first. Existing aria-live='polite' regions (cart, items grid) cover content updates.
a11y_evaluation.keyboard_navigation: Tab order: Tracker → Customer Screen → Floorplan|Loyalty → No-sale → Caisse. Loyalty button sits where Floorplan is, sibling not stacked, so tab order length unchanged.
a11y_evaluation.focus_management: Modal focus on code input already wired (PosLoyaltyRedeemModal.vue:232-240). After modal close, focus should return to the trigger button — add ref + nextTick focus restore in modal close handler.

keys_reused: pos.loyalty.redeem.title — already exists FR/EN/AR (resources/js/languages/fr.json:255, en.json:255, ar.json existing).
new_keys_required: pos.loyalty.redeem.cta_disabled_hint — 'Aucune commande en cours' / 'No active order' / 'لا يوجد طلب نشط'. RECOMMENDED but optional (can fall back to :title with existing i18n).
i18n_evaluation.rtl_considerations: PosV5Button + nav already support RTL (ltr:/rtl: classes). Emoji icon stays in template literal — no flip needed.
i18n_evaluation.raw_label_check: Confirm no hardcoded 'Loyalty' or 'Fidélité' strings in new code. All via $t().

edge_cases: User with permission=denied (server 403): modal still opens, error band shows on submit. CTA itself doesn't need permission gate (server is authoritative). UX: modal error is sufficient.
Network offline (isOnline=false): CTA still clickable. Backend call queues or 503s. Modal's existing error handler surfaces via :title 'pos.loyalty.redeem.errors.generic'.

Cashier opens modal, cart auto-reset by another tab (multi-tab): currentLoyaltyOrderId stale. Mitigation: modal already validates `canApply` on each input — when server returns ORDER_ALREADY_FINALIZED, modal shows clear error.
Cashier opens modal but doesn't submit (clicks Cancel): no side-effect, CTA tone unchanged. Modal close behavior already wired.
Rapid click on CTA (double-tap): modal's :open prop is boolean — second click is idempotent. No race condition.

verdict: GO. Placement is operator-bar sibling to floorplan link, gated by !dineInEnabled. UX state machine: hidden (V2 dine-in) | disabled (no order) | active (non-terminal order). A11y compliant via PosV5Button primitive. i18n keys reused; one optional new key for disabled hint. Recommend focus-restore on modal close for keyboard parity.
